summary: Banco de Chile filed a Form 6-K reporting the local-market placement of senior, dematerialized, bearer bonds, Series FT, totaling CLF 400,000 (approximately USD 18 million equivalent), maturing October 1, 2032, at an average placement rate of 2.88%. This is a routine debt issuance under Chilean regulatory disclosure requirements and not a special-situation event. No equity, control, or strategic transaction is involved; the filing merely notifies the market of standard corporate financing activity. There is no transaction structure, advisor, or risk-arbitrage angle to analyze.
